info.title: IBM Maximo REST API (Maximo Manage / Asset Management)
info.description: The REST/JSON API of IBM Maximo Asset Management 7.6 and Maximo Manage (MAS 8/9): the NextGen object-structure API under /maximo/oslc (session, maxauth or LDAP) and /maximo/api (API keys), its metadata, auth, attachments, lookups, services, automation-script, logging and Migration Manager routes, plus the legacy MIF REST API under /maxrest/rest (os, mbo, ss). Object structures are configured per installation, so record bodies are modelled generically. The OpenFn maximo adaptor resolves configuration.baseUrl + an arbitrary endpoint and sends the maxauth header: fetch() GETs it (then re-POSTs the body to postUrl), update() POSTs JSON with x-method-override: PATCH and patchtype: MERGE (the NextGen update convention), update75() POSTs a form body with the same headers.

servers.description: Maximo server (the adaptor's configuration.baseUrl). MAS 8/9 Manage: https://<workspace>.manage.<domain>.

post.summary: Create a record, or run a collection-level action / BULK / SYNC / import
post.description: Plain POST creates (201 + Location; body only with the properties header). x-method-override: BULK processes an array of add/update/delete in one call (always 200, per-item _responsemeta). x-method-override: SYNC upserts via the collection URL. ?action=importfile imports CSV/XML/JSON (preview first, then commit). ?action=wsmethod:<m> with BULK runs an action on many records.

Resource.description: One Maximo record serialised through an object structure. Attribute names are the MBO attributes in lower case when lean=1 (prefixed with the spi:/rdf: namespaces when lean=0); child objects appear as nested arrays/objects and related collections as {href} links. Contents depend entirely on the object structure, which is configured per installation.

href.description: Canonical URI of the record (contains the rest id).

_rowstamp.description: Optimistic-locking row stamp; send back in the If-Match header to detect concurrent updates.

doclinks.description: Link to the record's attachments collection.

ResponseInfo.description: Paging metadata of a collection response.

ResourceCollection.description: Collection (query) response. With count=1 the body is only {totalCount}; with distinct=<attr> it is a bare array of values instead.

totalCount.description: Only in the count=1 form of the response.

BulkResponseItem.description: One entry of a BULK response, in request order.

_responsedata.description: The item's body (the record when 'properties' was requested, or an {Error} object).

attrerrors.description: Batched attribute errors (when batch error reporting is enabled).

ApiRoot.description: API home document: links (systeminfo, whoami, installedProducts, serverMembers, license, apimeta, …) plus current date-time, language and calendar.

WhoAmI.description: Profile of the logged-in user (personid, userid, displayname, defaultsite, insertOrg, langcode, …); exact fields vary by release.

SystemInfo.description: System information of the deployed Maximo instance (application version, database, app server, …). Shape not documented field by field.

ObjectStructureMeta.description: Metadata of an API-eligible object structure: JSON schema, saved queries, creation API URL and the security application.

AdminModeState.description: Admin-mode state of the target instance.

LegacyResponse.description: Legacy MIF REST (maxrest) JSON serialisation (_format=json). The serializer wraps records in a Query<OS>Response (os) or <MBO>MboSet (mbo) envelope carrying rsStart/rsCount/rsTotal; field names are upper-case MBO attributes. Exact nesting is serializer-configurable (mxe.rest.serializer.*) and not specified field by field here.

Generic.description: Response shape not documented field by field.

objectStructure.name: objectStructure
objectStructure.description: Object structure name, e.g. mxapiasset, mxapiwodetail, mxapipo, mxapiperuser, mxapimeter, mxapiapikey (case-insensitive). Which object structures exist is installation-specific (see /apimeta).

restId.name: restId
restId.description: Encoded rest id taken from a record's href (e.g. _MTAwMS9CRURGT1JE).

select.name: oslc.select
select.description: Attributes to return, e.g. assetnum,status,location.description or *. Supports child objects (rel.name{attrs}).

pageSize.name: oslc.pageSize
pageSize.description: Page size; responseInfo then carries nextPage/previousPage.

gbcols.name: gbcols
gbcols.description: Group-by columns (with aggregate functions), e.g. status,count.*

distinct.name: distinct
distinct.description: Attribute to return distinct values for.

addschema.name: addschema
addschema.description: Include the JSON schema in the response.

action.name: action
action.description: Action to invoke: wsmethod:<method> (e.g. wsmethod:changeStatus, wsmethod:approve), workflow:<processname>, system:addimage / system:deleteimage / system:candelete, importfile, listreports, genreport.

reportname.name: reportname
reportname.description: BIRT report design for action=genreport (e.g. woprint.rptdesign).

interactive.name: interactive
interactive.description: 1 = interactive logic: yes/no/cancel prompts are returned to the client.

checkesig.name: checkesig
checkesig.description: 1 = fail with BMXAA9766E when an e-signature-enabled attribute changes.

properties.name: properties
properties.description: Attributes to return in the response body of a create/update (* for all); without it a create returns 201 with only a Location header.

methodOverride.name: x-method-override
methodOverride.description: Tunnel PATCH/DELETE over POST, process an array body as a BULK transaction, or SYNC (create-or-update on the collection URL).

patchtype.name: patchtype
patchtype.description: MERGE = merge child objects instead of replacing them on PATCH (the OpenFn update()/update75() send this).

transactionid.name: transactionid
transactionid.description: Client-generated id; the server rejects a repeat within the OSLCTXN window (duplicate-request protection).

esigauth.name: esigauth
esigauth.description: Base64 e-signature password/key answering an esig challenge.

apikeyQuery.name: apikey
apikeyQuery.description: API key as a query parameter (the apikey header is preferred).

legacyFormat.name: _format
legacyFormat.description: Response format; XML is the default, so pass json.

legacyRsStart.name: _rsStart
legacyRsStart.description: Zero-based index of the first record (paging).

legacyLid.name: _lid
legacyLid.description: Native-auth user id (legacy alternative to the maxauth header).

mbo.name: mbo
mbo.description: Business object name, e.g. workorder, asset, inventory, invbalances, person.

legacyOs.name: objectStructure
legacyOs.description: Integration object structure, e.g. mxinventory, mxwo, mxasset, mxperson.

legacyId.name: id
legacyId.description: Unique id of the record (e.g. WORKORDERID, PERSONUID).

apiRoot.name: apiRoot
apiRoot.description: oslc = session/maxauth/LDAP routes; api = API-key route (/maximo/api), needed for headless calls when SAML/OIDC is on.

maxauth.name: maxauth
maxauth.description: Maximo native authentication: base64(user:password). What the OpenFn adaptor sends.

apikeyHeader.name: apikey
apikeyHeader.description: API key (from /apitoken/create or the MXAPIAPIKEY object structure); use with the /maximo/api route.

basicAuth.description: HTTP Basic, for LDAP / app-server security.
